Attached: 1 image

I got another #programming book to bolster my #clang skills. 

I’m becoming frustrated with my professors not really doing much to encourage us to actually think and learn (for a ton of structural reasons to be fair) so I’m taking initiative on my own behalf. I am a bit perturbed my university experience is mostly self-study.

I know most of my fundamentals but I’m not quite good at thinking systematically. The book seems to be a good starting point to improving that skill. Always be reading.
